title: rule.withdrawn
description: A published rule version was withdrawn and stops being in force, either by an analyst or because a newer version that withdraws it took effect. Producer: rulebook (on withdrawal, or when the withdrawing version takes effect). Consumers: applicability-engine, obligation, qa.
x-producer: rulebook (on withdrawal, or when the withdrawing version takes effect)

rule_version_id.description: The version that is now withdrawn.

withdrawn_by_rule_version_id.description: The version that withdraws it; null when an analyst withdrew it directly.

effective_from.description: The day the withdrawal took effect.
